changes.change: Comment above isOsError reworded: only OS errors become E_WRITE; any other exception is a program error, rollback and cleanup run, then it is rethrown unchanged with its stack trace; no catch in the section turns it into E_WRITE or drops it. Replaces the loose closing sentence 'Nothing in this section catches "everything"'. 3 lines replace 2, plus one line more.

Two comment lines above the fs.writeFileSync of the temp file: no `encoding` in these options, on purpose; with encoding "utf8" Node 22.21.1 takes a fast path that ignores `flush`, so fs.fsyncSync is silently not called.
Two comment lines above the fs.writeFileSync of each file in the temporary run folder: no `encoding` here either (see stage()); it would silently turn the fsync of `flush: true` off.
